scripts.check: npm run check:types && npm run check:boundaries
scripts.check:types: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit --pretty false && npm run build:packages && tsc -p packages/presentation/tsconfig.worklet.json --pretty false && vue-tsc -p apps/vue-player/tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:assets && npm run build -w @ubve/vue-player
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:qualification
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/core packages/testkit packages/io-demux packages/wasm-adapters packages/native-bridge packages/presentation packages/disc packages/browser --pretty false
scripts.build:assets: node scripts/build-codecs.mjs && node scripts/prepare-presentation-assets.mjs && node scripts/prepare-disc-assets.mjs && python3 scripts/generate-support.py && node scripts/check-assets.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build:assets && npm run dev -w @ubve/vue-player
